designer_note: Designed by Opus running the /ases-ui-design role because no Gemini agent is available in this Claude Code session. Spec is platform-neutral and re-runnable by Gemini if/when integrated.
scope_excludes: F-012 — verification-only feature, no UI surface (its semantics are verified by integration tests against the dashboard)
integration_points: GET /api/v1/dealers → list[DealerRead]   (S1, existing — filter dropdown + places derivation)
integration_boundary_note: Two NEW api wrapper files extend the existing pattern: `frontend/src/lib/api/dashboard.ts` and `frontend/src/lib/api/reports.ts`. Components/hooks import only from these wrappers. The wrappers initially read from `mocks.ts`; Sonnet swaps to real `apiClient` calls at /ases-ui-scaffold S3 (one-line change per function) — same pattern as S2's `lib/api/transactions.ts`.

new_types.shape: { design_id: number; design_name: string; size: string; grade_id: number; grade_code: string; opening: number; inward: number; outward: number; adjust: number; closing: number }

new_api_wrappers.during_scaffold: imports MOCK_DASHBOARD_ROWS from mocks.ts and filters/projects synthetically based on asOfDate
new_api_wrappers.during_integration: Sonnet replaces with `await apiClient.get('/dashboard', { params: { as_of_date: asOfDate } }).then(r => r.data)`

new_api_wrappers.during_scaffold: imports MOCK_SALES + MOCK_DESIGNS + MOCK_DEALERS and applies the filter set client-side to build both arrays + verify AC-050 reconciliation
new_api_wrappers.during_integration: Sonnet replaces with `await apiClient.get('/reports/sales', { params: <repeat-key list serialization> }).then(r => r.data)`. CRITICAL: must use axios `paramsSerializer` (or URLSearchParams) that emits repeat-key form for list params (`?dealer_ids=1&dealer_ids=2`), NOT comma-joined. FastAPI's native list parsing depends on this.

additions: MOCK_DASHBOARD_ROWS: DashboardRow[] — 6 rows covering 2 designs × 3 grades (the S1 seed combinatorics) with varied opening/inward/outward/adjust/closing so the UI can render every column non-trivially

Existing MOCK_SALES is sufficient for the Sales Report (already shipped in S2 ui-scaffold); just extend MOCK_SALES with a few extra lines to make the consolidation grouping visible (≥2 sales per (design, grade) pair so total_nos > nos)

components.name: DashboardPage
components.purpose: Server component wrapper hosting the DashboardView client component. Sets page title 'Stock Dashboard' + breadcrumb 'Admin / Dashboard'.
interactions: renders <DashboardView />
components.responsive_note: inherits the existing app/admin/layout.tsx shell — no page-level responsive concerns
components.a11y_note:
Stock Dashboard

at the top sets the page landmark

components.name: DashboardView
components.purpose: Container client component. Owns the as_of_date state (URL-synced via Next.js search params), drives the date picker, and renders DashboardTable + states (loading / empty / error).
components.state: asOfDate: string (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today; persisted to URL `?as_of_date=...`)
interactions: On mount + on asOfDate change: useQuery(['dashboard', asOfDate], () => getDashboard(asOfDate))
DateRangePicker single-date variant (or single DatePicker) updates asOfDate; URL syncs via router.replace
Refetch button calls queryClient.invalidateQueries(['dashboard', asOfDate])
components.responsive_note: header (title + picker + refetch) stacks vertically on mobile (< 640px), inline on tablet+ (≥ 640px). Padding scales: px-4 (mobile) / px-6 (tablet) / px-8 (desktop).
components.a11y_note: DatePicker has aria-label='Dashboard as-of date'; refetch button is a real <button> with aria-label='Refresh dashboard'.

components.name: DashboardDatePicker
components.purpose: Calendar-popover input for selecting the as-of date. Reuses the existing shadcn calendar.tsx (TD-001 patch still applies).
interactions: Click button → popover opens → select date → format to YYYY-MM-DD → call onChange(newValue) → popover closes
components.responsive_note: button width: w-full sm:w-[240px]. Popover content uses align='start' on desktop, align='center' on mobile.
components.a11y_note: aria-haspopup='dialog' on the trigger button; arrow keys navigate the calendar grid (react-day-picker default)

components.name: DashboardTable
components.purpose: Renders DashboardRow[] in a shadcn Table. 10 columns matching the LLD: Design Name, Size, Grade, Opening, Inward, Outward, Adjust, Closing (+ design_id, grade_id hidden for keying). Sorted by (design_name ASC, grade_code ASC) — server already sorts; component does NOT re-sort.
interactions: While isLoading: renders 6 skeleton rows (mobile shows 3) via shadcn <Skeleton />
On rows.length === 0 && !isLoading: render <EmptyDashboardState />
Numeric columns (Opening/Inward/Outward/Adjust/Closing) right-aligned via Tailwind tabular-nums text-right
Outward column is positive integer per the API contract (no minus sign)
components.responsive_note: On mobile (< 640px), the table horizontally scrolls inside an overflow-x-auto wrapper — keeps all 8 columns visible without truncation. On tablet+ (≥ 640px), table fills container width. Sticky column 1 (Design Name) on mobile so users always see the row identity while scrolling movements.
components.a11y_note: <table> with proper <thead>/<tbody>; first cell of each row is <th scope='row'> for Design Name + Grade combo; tabular-nums on numeric cells for monospace alignment

components.name: EmptyDashboardState
components.purpose: Renders when GET /dashboard returns []. Provides a clear message + CTA: 'No active design-grade pairs yet — create one in Admin → Design-Grade Mapping' (links to /admin/design-grade-map).
interactions: Link to /admin/design-grade-map via next/link
components.a11y_note: with semantic text; CTA is a real anchor

components.name: SalesReportPage
components.purpose: Server component wrapper hosting SalesReportView. Sets title 'Sales Report' + breadcrumb 'Admin / Reports / Sales'.
interactions: renders <SalesReportView />

components.name: SalesReportView
components.purpose: Container. Owns the 5-filter form state (URL-synced), drives the FilterBar, and renders the dual-payload result. Per AC-049: Consolidation FIRST, then Transactions, both on the same screen — no tabs, no toggle.
components.state: filters: SalesReportFilters (date_from, date_to, dealer_ids: number[], places: string[], design_ids: number[]); all optional; URL-synced
interactions: useQuery(['sales-report', filters], () => getSalesReport(filters)) — re-runs on every filter change
FilterBar's 'Apply' button triggers a single batched update (avoids 5 round-trips per typing event)
'Reset' clears all filters and triggers a refetch with no filters (full dataset per RULE-018)
Sum reconciliation badge (defense-in-depth): displays 'Reconciled: 28 / 28 ✓' or red-X if mismatch — the server has already asserted AC-050; this is a visible sanity tick for the PO
api_deps: GET /api/v1/dealers — for the dealer multi-select options
GET /api/v1/designs — for the design multi-select options
(places list is DERIVED from the loaded dealers' .place values, deduped — no new endpoint)
components.responsive_note: On mobile: FilterBar collapses to a single 'Filters (N active)' button → opens a Sheet/Drawer with the full form. Consolidation table renders FIRST (sticky on scroll), then Transactions below. On desktop: FilterBar sticks to the top of the content area; Consolidation and Transactions tables render in two stacked cards.

components.name: SalesReportFilterBar
components.purpose: 5-control filter form. All controls multi-select OR optional single fields (date range is 2 single dates). Applies as a single 'Apply' click to avoid filter-noise re-fetches.
components.props: { initialFilters: SalesReportFilters; onApply: (filters: SalesReportFilters) => void; onReset: () => void; dealers: DealerRead[]; designs: TradingDesignRead[]; places: string[] }
components.state: draftFilters (local; not propagated until Apply clicked)
interactions: Date From + Date To: two DashboardDatePicker instances (clearable via 'X' icon)
Dealers: MultiSelectCombobox over dealers list, returns dealer_ids: number[]
Places: MultiSelectCombobox over derived places list
Designs: MultiSelectCombobox over designs list, returns design_ids: number[]
Apply button (primary): emits draftFilters via onApply
Reset button (ghost): clears draftFilters AND emits empty filters via onReset
components.responsive_note: 5 controls + 2 buttons arrange responsively: mobile = stack vertically; tablet = 2-column grid; desktop = single row of 5 fields + 2 buttons with flex-wrap. Apply/Reset right-aligned on desktop, full-width on mobile.
components.a11y_note: All controls wrapped in <Label htmlFor=...>; Apply button has type='submit' inside a <form onSubmit={preventDefault → onApply}>

components.name: MultiSelectCombobox
components.purpose: shadcn Combobox-pattern multi-select with check-mark chips. Used by 3 of the 5 filter controls. Reusable for future V2 multi-selects.
components.props: { options: Array<{ value: string | number; label: string }>; value: Array<string | number>; onChange: (next: Array<string | number>) => void; placeholder: string; emptyMessage?: string; searchable?: boolean (default true) }
components.state: internal popover-open boolean + search input value
interactions: Click → popover with searchable list
Click an option → toggles its presence in value
Selected items render as chips below the trigger with 'x' to remove
Search input filters the list (case-insensitive substring)
TD-010 NOTE: jsdom can't drive Radix Combobox internals — UI scaffold tests will mock this component with a native <select multiple> shim per TD-010's recommended option (a)
components.responsive_note: Trigger button width: w-full on mobile, w-[180px] on tablet+. Popover uses Radix Popover responsive defaults.
components.a11y_note: aria-haspopup='listbox'; aria-multiselectable='true'; chips are <button aria-label='Remove X'>

components.name: ConsolidationTable
components.purpose: Renders ConsolidationRow[]. 6 columns: Design Name, Size, Grade, Total Nos. (server pre-sorted by design_name ASC, grade_code ASC per RULE-019). Sum-of-total_nos row at the bottom (computed client-side from rendered rows).
interactions: Skeleton rows on isLoading
Empty state shows 'No matching sales' when rows.length === 0 && !isLoading
Footer row: 'Total' label spanning Design+Size+Grade cells, total_nos sum right-aligned
components.responsive_note: Same overflow-x-auto + sticky design-name pattern as DashboardTable
components.a11y_note: <tfoot> for the total row; <th scope='row'> on first cell

components.name: TransactionsTable
components.purpose: Renders TransactionRow[]. 7 visible columns (sales_date, dealer_name, place, design_name+size, grade_code, nos). Server pre-sorted by (sales_date ASC, header_id ASC) per RULE-020. Footer row shows sum-of-nos for client-side AC-050 verification badge.
interactions: Skeleton, Empty state, Footer total — same pattern as ConsolidationTable
components.responsive_note: Mobile: hide place + size columns by default; reveal via expand toggle in a row's last cell. Desktop: all 7 visible.
components.a11y_note: tabular-nums on numeric column; sales_date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD with abbr title='ISO date' if shown

components.name: ReconciliationBadge
components.purpose: Visible AC-050 verification: sums consolidation.total_nos and transactions.nos and renders 'Reconciled: 28 / 28 ✓' when equal, '⚠ Mismatch' otherwise. Server has already asserted AC-050 (will 500 if violated); this badge gives the PO a visible green-tick for confidence.
interactions: Computes once per render; visual-only
components.responsive_note: Inline badge near the section header; wraps to its own line on mobile
components.a11y_note: aria-live='polite' so screen readers announce when the value changes after filter changes

components.name: EmptyReportState
components.purpose: Renders when both consolidation and transactions are empty. Message: 'No sales match the current filters. Try clearing filters or widening the date range.' + a 'Clear filters' button.
interactions: Clear-filters button calls onClear()
components.a11y_note: Clear button is a real <button> with aria-label='Clear all filters'

shared_state_strategy.url_sync: Both pages use Next.js useSearchParams + router.replace to keep the current dashboard date / sales filters in the URL. This makes deep-linked dashboards bookmarkable (e.g. /admin/dashboard?as_of_date=2026-06-15) and supports back-button.
react_query_keys: ['sales-report', filters]   // filters object serialized via JSON.stringify in the key
shared_state_strategy.stale_time: 60 seconds for masters (dealers/designs); 0 (always refetch) for dashboard + sales report — reports must reflect latest data

patterns: Tables: overflow-x-auto wrapper on mobile to preserve all columns
Filter bar: vertical stack on mobile, single row with flex-wrap on desktop
Sticky elements: first table column sticky on mobile to retain row identity
Multi-selects: full-width chip area on mobile, fixed-width 240px on desktop

accessibility_checklist: Tab order: from top (date picker / filter bar) to bottom (tables)
All numeric columns right-aligned + tabular-nums for predictable scanning

Empty + error states have semantic

with role-appropriate aria
Toast notifications via sonner for error states (auto-dismiss, but also aria-live for screen readers)
Color contrast: shadcn radix-nova defaults meet WCAG AA
loading_strategy: react-query's isLoading drives shadcn <Skeleton /> components inside the tables (6 skeleton rows for dashboard, 10 for sales report tables). Empty states only render when isLoading === false AND rows.length === 0.
error_strategy: react-query's isError drives a shared <ErrorState /> component (reused from S1) inside the table area. Toast via sonner for the actual error message. Retry button calls queryClient.refetchQueries.
future_concerns_not_in_s3_scope: Pagination on /reports/sales (currently returns full filtered set; flagged in sprint_summary suggested_prd_updates for V2)
CSV / PDF export on either page (PRD V2 deferred)
Chart panel on dashboard (LLD frontend_ui_track_note marked optional; table-only ships in S3)
Date-range picker on dashboard (single date only per AC-041; V2 might add ranges)
